description: Use when an individual (фізична особа) asks how much duty/VAT (мито, ПДВ, розмитнення) they will pay for a personal parcel. Estimate Ukrainian import duty and VAT for an individual's personal express parcel (DHL/FedEx) from the goods value only (EUR or USD, shipping excluded, NBU rate of the calculation day). Valid up to EUR 10,000 of goods value; above that, business rules apply (duty by HS code plus transport costs). Not for business imports. For companies use check_customs and a broker consultation.

goodsValue.description: Вартість лише товару (без доставки) в EUR або USD; до 10 000 євро.
